notes: §2002:12.3.4.6.2 SR3: one file-level COLLATING SEQUENCE clause is accepted beside a key-level one and orders the prime key by its alphabet (P:ZZ/XX/AA) while the key-level native alphabet orders the alternate key (A:AA/XX/ZZ), per §2002:12.3.4.6.3 GR2 and GR6; a second file-level clause is refused with COBOL1582. Both run at --std 2002 as derived.
